items.author: Jon Hamm
items.body_excerpt: Crazy that Micah Peavy was traded by the Pelicans to the Grizz late in the summer, played preseason with Memphis, got waived, gets an opportunity in OKC largely thanks to Otega Oweh's torn achilles, is probably still living out of a suitcase, and is now playing solid ball for a title contender.
